title: DJ Mehdi gets a square named after him in Paris.
summary: Mayor Emmanuel Grégoire announced the decision to honor the French-Tunisian music producer on Friday. In a post on Instagram , he said, “By naming a square in Paris after him, we pay tribute to a truly great artist.
